Name: (CP) Stardew Foliage
Author: AngelOfStars
Description:
[size=3]Someone asked a question about there being placeable tree furniture in the game... and I couldn't find one at the time so I decided to make one. It was a pain - but here it is! 

This mod [i]adds[/i] ~317 furniture pieces to the game using Content Patcher.

You can find the furniture in the general furniture catalogue that you can buy from Robin.

Alternatively you can install [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20628]Calcifer[/url] and use the Foliage Furniture Catalogue to purchase the items (you can also buy that from Robin)

You can also use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/93]CJB Item Spawner[/url] and type in "Foliage" to find the furniture.

To edit configs use [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]

Because of the way Content Patcher does furniture, I couldn't make the big trees have a 1x1 base in the center. That means that most of them have a 2x1 bounding box starting at the left, so you won't be able to place furniture there or walk through it on that side. I suggest using 

[url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23488]Precise Furniture[/url] and/or [url=http://github.com/Sparky56p/AnythingAnywhere/releases]Anything Anywhere[/url] for furniture placement. Alternatively you can also use the [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3900]NoClip[/url] mod to walk through it at any point

[b]Installation:[/b]
1. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
2. Install this mod.
3. Extract all and drop them into your Mods folder.

If you have any other suggestions I can try to implement them!

For Translators: 
You may upload your translation file to Nexus, just be sure to make this mod a requirement + don't upload the actual code!

[b][i]If you like the stuff I make, consider sending me a [url=https://ko-fi.com/lilydoesthingssometimes]ko-fi[/url]﻿ - never required of course, I do this stuff for fun, but it does make it easier to focus on making things.[/i][/b]

[/size]Credits:
